parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: This is the flush button of the toilet, typically made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It activates the flushing mechanism when pressed, releasing water from the tank into the bowl.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically or pivots slightly when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: This is another flush button, often part of a dual-flush system, made of plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It provides an alternative flush option, typically for a smaller volume of water to conserve resources.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically or pivots slightly when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the toilet, made of glazed ceramic for durability and hygiene.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the user, contains the bowl, and channels waste to the plumbing system.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving structure that provides stability and houses internal water and waste channels.
